sourceReview.reason: The resolved Coinfomania article is an AI-generated summary of a Token Terminal social post, not independent reporting. Spiko's October 6 primary update reported $2.7 billion of total fund assets, but no dated primary series or second independent full-text report verifies the claimed $2.5 billion annual increase.
